speaker: Eric Green
title: CEO at West Pharmaceutical Services

Overall, we expect HPP components' revenues to grow mid-single digits in 2025, down from our previous expectations of mid to high single digits, a change driven by mix and timing. A key driver of HPP components' growth is our ability to capitalize on the significant opportunities in the GLP-1 market. Our HPP GLP-1 elastomer business is performing well, growing to about 7% of total revenues in the first quarter. Furthermore, we continue to make progress with our biologics customers, solidifying our position as the global leader in this space.

speaker: Eric Green
title: CEO at West Pharmaceutical Services
msg: There are two parts to our biologics business that I would like to address individually. However, the growth will reverse in the second half of 2025 when we comp against the significant incentive payments we received in Q3 and Q4 of last year. The largest portion of the portfolio within biologics is HPP components, and this has a positive trend. These are pacing negative in the first and second quarters of 2025, a function of tail-end destocking. We anticipate that this trend will reverse and expect a high single-digit growth rate in the second half of 2025 for biologics HPP components.

speaker: Eric Green
title: CEO at West Pharmaceutical Services

speaker: Eric Green
title: CEO at West Pharmaceutical Services
msg: The growth in this area was driven by a continued volume ramp in SmartDose in the first quarter of 2025. We have a twofold strategy for this area of our business. First, we're working hard to drive significant margin improvement as we move forward. Second, we continue to evaluate the best path forward for this business, and all options remain on the table.

speaker: Eric Green
title: CEO at West Pharmaceutical Services

We continue to work towards filling the space and onboarding new contracts as we continue to execute on this business. Our goal is to continue growing our Contract Manufacturing business and moving into drug handling, which we believe will be higher margin and comes with lower capital intensity.

Bernard has been an invaluable partner, an advisor to me in the entire organization. His contributions and leadership over the past seven years have been instrumental to our success. He will be missed.

speaker: Bernard Birkett
title: CFO at West Pharmaceutical Services
